nom: Perricone MD Neuropeptide Deep Crease Serum

avis.texte: I am really loving the deep crease serum. I'll be 58 soon and this serum has improved the look of my fine lines and deeper nasal fold wrinkles. It feels really good on my skin. The only complaint is the dropper doesn't pick up the product very well.
This really does help the deep lines around my mouth. One would think since I have had these lines for so many years, they would be ingrained. But I can tell an improvement in a month.

It feels lightweight and smooth on the skin, and it sinks in pretty quickly without leaving behind any sticky or greasy feeling. It layers well with the rest of my skincare too, which I always appreciate. It definitely has that luxe, high-end feel, both in the formula and the packaging. My skin feels softer and more hydrated after using it.
This product is awesome. I started noticing creases around my mouth and use this twice a day and they have really started to fade. 5 stars!!

Once again, Influenster and Dr Perricone comes along with a phenomenal product! Thai was given to me to try and let me tell you, what a great, easy, premium product this is! First- it's unavoidable to mention it is a premium product with a premium price point. BUT- it responds with premium results! I started using this as my go to serum, preceded by my face wash, toner and essence. After those steps, I apply a reasonable amount of this (about half a dime sized drop) and I applied it to the sides of my nose, where smile lines are. It absorbs nicely and isn't sticky or tacky. I finish with a simple moisturizer and that's it. At first, no big deal… but after about 2 weeks, I have noticed some softening of these crease lines. Mind you I've had them a while, so I'm definitely managing expectations here. But the fact that after only 2 weeks I've seen them start to soften, and from a topical- I'll take it! I'm eager to see how it goes in 2 months. I really appreciate that this is a very smooth, absorbable serum. No issues with pilling or feeling heavy. I am a bit concerned about the maintenance once I finish this, as it is a truly premium priced product, but if it works, it's definitely a lot less than injectables and cos med interventions. I'll keep applying it and look forward to the results!

avis.titre: Such a gentle serum- love it!
avis.texte: I tried this serum because of my smile lines and was pleasantly surprised. It's lightweight but still hydrating and with regular use those lines look a lot softer and less noticeable. My skin feels firmer after all. It's not an overnight fix but I did see a difference over time.
I've used this wrong mole treatment for almost one year. I'm 83 with hardly a deep wrinkle. It's a miracle cream!!

This serum is a good hydrator to help plump skin and as a result, reduce the visibility of creases. I used it awhile to ensure I could write an informed review, and while it didn't eliminate any creases (I have one horizontal one on my neck plus deep nasolabial folds, those areas did appear smoother than before. The dropper was a little weird in that I could only get about one drop at a time but I guess it helped not waste product.
This high potential deep crease serum if full of super power ingredients, neuro peptides, that helps smooth those pesky wrinkles. It's a luxury product and you def get the results you're looking for.

I am not new to Perricone MD products, so I was excited to try their deep crease serum. Especially, now that I'm older, I have seen a change in my skin. Especially the elasticity, texture, and increase in fine lines and wrinkles. I have deep smile lines that make my makeup application difficult. Using this product has made them smoother and less noticeable even without makeup use. These pictures are months apart and my no makeup look is much more improved than my makeup look. And this is without consistent nightly use. I'm very pleased with my results.
I have been using for about a month and some of the wrinkles I have been concerned about are easing
I received this product, the bottle was half empty and the dropper did not work. I would not buy this again, waste of money.

The serum was light weight and absorbed easily. It doesn't leave any residue on skin and could easily be worn under make up. I have noticed it makes my skin feel more plump. I'm still waiting to see the long term results but I've notice some improvement in fine lines.

I'm enjoying using this serum. I've been applying it on the area between my eyebrows. That's where I'm most self conscious about my wrinkles. I'm still gauging the results. It is concentrated so a little goes a long way. I'll keep using it to see what the final results are. So far so good!

avis.titre: Feels great, pending long term results.
avis.texte: This serum goes on smooth and absorbs well, working well under makeup - no beading or pilling of my makeup, which I like. However, while I do like the product and will continue to use it, I can't say I've seen a miraculous difference in my creases. Will continue using to see if the long term effects are noticeable.
This softened my skin! I haven't used it enough to see if it helps with creases but overall I really love this product and recommend it for other people!

First of all, the packaging for this serum is consistent with all Perricone MD skincare products - A luxe but minimalist style frosted glass bottle with a pump. This serum feels lightweight and absorbs quickly without feeling sticky or greasy (and a pea sized amount goes a long way). It also does not pill when used with other skincare products. You won't see results overnight but with consistent use, I have noticed that my fine lines are softer / less noticeable and my skin looks plumper. Finally, I experienced no irritation or sensitivity. For those sensitive to smell though, there is a slight fragrance to it but it is not overwhelming. I would highly recommend this product to anyone looking for a skincare product designed to address wrinkles/fine lines. I received this product in exchange for my honest review.
I love a good serum and always looking for something that will not irritate my sensitive skin. This serum is lovely and gets in all the crevices without drying or feeling sticky.

First off I wanna say this texture is nice and creamy but very absorbent. The reduction in the lines and wrinkles on my skin dramatically improves. Love that the bottle is glass easy to recycle. My only issue is sometimes it was hard to remove the product from the bottle with the eyedropper applicator, you had to shake it around a little bit just to move the product around to be able to suction it with the eyedrop applicator. That one concern does not take away from the quality and efficacy of this product!

I used the Perricone MD Neuropeptide Deep Crease Serum along with the Perricone MD Neuropeptide Moisturizer SPF 25 and overall I thought it was okay. I really liked the texture, it's very lightweight and layers well without feeling heavy. I did notice a slight reduction in my forehead crease, but the results were subtle and didn't exceed my expectations.

This is a very nice thick serum. I like that is not runny as there is less waste. I have been using it daily for a few weeks and I think I see a softening of lines on my forehead and face I apply this serum only to areas of my face with lines, let it dry and follow with moisturizer. It works well under makeup I will continue to use this product and hope to see even more results!

This serum is thicker than the average serum. It's rich and makes you feel like you are filling the creases and fine lines on your face. It feels smooth and skin feels extra supple. I primarily use this serum at night. No scent just moisture. I would say it would be skin sensitive safe.

I have combination skin leaning more towards dry living here in AZ. Will it get rid of your wrinkles? No. But is it really moisturizing? Also no. This was a fail for me. The serum is too think for the dropper. Just give me a pump! I have no results or changes in skin after a month. If anything it dried out my skin more.

The texture of this is nice, easy to absorb, not greasy. I did notice a difference in my forehead while using this product. It's smoother, and less fine lines. I would recommend this product on top of Botox-if you get Botox. If not alone you would still notice a difference.

Love this! Love the milky, thicker texture which feels amazing when applying to my face. Left my skin feeling plump. I really like the droppers for serums so I can just drop the product where I want it & it's easy to safely store. I have lines on my forehead and so I'm really excited to keep using this crease serum to help reduce those lines. Does not dry or irritate skin. Only con is this is quite pricey!

This was given to me as an incentive for an honest review. The texture comes out of the dropper goopy. It has a pretty strong fragrance. It absorbs completely into the skin. Wears well under makeup. A little goes a long way. Had no breakouts with this. But I just don't care for skin products to be super fragrance. It's almost like a spa type smell mixed with a citrus like smell. It gives a very saddle glow. Not oily. I'm not sure that I would purchase this one out of personal preference. The fragrance lasts for quite a while.

First of all, the dropper is horrible. I am not sure why there isn't a regular pump instead. It does have a scent which I personally don't mind and find it pleasant, something between coconut and flowers. The serum is thicker but once massaged it feels lightweight and it doesn't pill. It takes some time to see some results. After a couple of weeks my skin seemed more plumped and fine lines little less visible. But the results were not big enough for me to repurchase this serum. The ingredients are also not ideal and could be irritating for some with sensitive skin. That being said, I also used the Perricone MD Neuropeptide moisturizer with SPF BEFORE I was using this serum and that moisturizer is absolutely fantastic and I had way better results with that without this serum.

avis.titre: I have quickly seen a huge difference in the amount of mo...
avis.texte: Perricone MD Deep Crease Serum is like magic! It is so moisturizing without being sticky or greasy. It absorbs but still leaves visible moisture. You only need about 3 drops, not dropper full, to cover your face, chest and necks. After a week I really saw a huge difference and realized how many of my line were visible because my skin was so dry.. It is even safe to use on the tine lines around my lips! My skin looks so amazing after using it consistently, so much more youthful and healthy. The scent is a little stronger initially than previous Perricone MD products I have used but after the first and second time I used it I didn't notice it as much. My skin feels so much more happy with so much more bounce back and elasticity. My makeup looks so much better ever since I have been using it, and my skin looks so radiant that I even skip the makeup and don't feel the need to hide my skin.

I've been really impressed with how moisturized this serum makes my skin look and feel. The texture is lightweight but potent, and it absorbs quickly without feeling heavy. After using it consistently for about 4 weeks, my skin looks more hydrated and my deeper expression lines appear slightly softer. This serum isn't overnight Botox in a box, but it's starting to make a noticeable difference so I'll definitely continue to use it.

I really like how this serum feels on my skin. It's silky smooth and has a very light, pleasant scent. It absorbs pretty quickly which is nice since it's supposed to fully dry before adding moisturizer. I can't say for sure if my fine lines have reduced very much, but I do feel like with continued use they will continue to improve. Definitely like this one. It has potential!

This deep crease serum is so silky and smooth to apply. After using it for a few weeks I do notice a difference with my wrinkles on my forehead, my smile lines and my frown lines. They look less pronounced and visible. If that's a concern for you then try this serum. I also love the subtle scent.

I've been using this Perricone MD deep crease serum for about two weeks and I am starting to see results! Specifically around my eye. My creasing around my eyes are appearing to be smoother. The serum isn't heavy, it's light and absorbs quickly. There is no scent, which is a huge plus in my book! If I see continued results, this will become a staple in my skin care!

avis.titre: Miracle Serum for Deep Forehead Creases
avis.texte: Perricone MD Neuropeptide Deep Crease Serum is just what my middle aged forehead needed! My forehead has several deep creases but with this formula I am seeing them minimized. I experienced no irritation. The dropper is perfect for precise measuring, making the value even better. I like the bottle and dropper, as it keeps my hands mostly clean and looks high end.

I've really been enjoying adding Perricone MD Deep Crease Serum into my skincare routine. Been using it twice a day before moisturizer. The consistency is lightweight and smooth. It absorbs into my skin without buildup or that tacky or greasy feeling. Feels good under makeup. Now that I am in my 40s, I am focusing more on preventing wrinkles and deep creases. I make sure to apply this serum in my laugh lines, frown lines and crows feet. With this serum in my routine, my lines appear softer and less noticeable. Makes my skin feel smoother. No redness or irritation noticed like when I use Retinol.

avis.titre: 86 years old and my skin looks younger
avis.texte: I liked the old version of deep crease serum, but this new version with neuropeptides is fabulous. My skin has an improved texture since I started using it. It's a little early to look for changes in wrinkles since I haven't been using it very long, but I'll report back later. I do notice a change (for the better) in fine lines.

The Perricone MD Neuropeptide Deep Crease Serum makes my skin feel so much smoother. It actually does not trigger my acne prone skin, which is great. I haven't seen my 11s improve yet but overall the feel of my skin feels more plump while using this. The smaller lighter wrinkles around my eyes seemed to have improved but have not disappeared entirely. It's currently part of my skincare routine and I will follow through and continue using it for better results.

avis.titre: Nice serum but has not helped much with deep creases
avis.texte: I received the Neuropeptide Deep Crease Serum from Perricone MD for free in exchange for my honest review. The packaging is very nice and the serum is contained in an amber glass bottle which is good for staving off oxidation of the ingredients. There's also a dropper top—the dropper I think could be improved as I have to squeeze it several times to get enough out to use, and this has been an issue every use. The serum has a nice consistency that is heavy enough to give nice moisturization but light enough to absorb quickly without leaving a greasy feeling. The scent is ok; I do feel like it's a little too floral—smells a bit like a cream for a grandmother but I can get past that; it's not an overwhelming scent so it's ok. I also do think that it is helping somewhat with wrinkles in the several weeks I've been using it but I do not feel like I've seen much improvement in deep creases really. I guess I would need to use it consistently for a few months to impact those but I don't really have enough product for 2 or 3 months worth. So I'm not really sure if I think it's worth the retail price. If the results are not really good for the deep creases then I don't think I could justify the price. I would say to give it a try if you have lots of disposable income to be able to try for several months, but for those on a strict budget I would not recommend it because of its cost.

I have been using this deep crease serum for a few weeks and my wrinkles are becoming less noticeable. The liquid is smooth on skin and handy dropper to squeeze just the perfect amount of drops to your liking. I used the serum on my forehead, above lip area and in between my brows. My skin responds well to this serum and I notice a difference right away after applying. Skin texture looks more even. Serum dries quickly and fully absorbed. Did not irritate my skin and has no scent to speak of. Love this serum for my mature skin!

avis.titre: Hydrating easy to apply minimizes wrinkles
avis.texte: I was able to try the Perricone MD neuropeptide deep cease serum. This serum is a bit thicket than a just hyaluronic serum. This serum has niacinamide to boost growth and minimize fine lines and wrinkles. I think it did help my skin retain moisture and elasticity. I also appreciated that it can be used day or night or even both! There are no harsh ingredients to irritate my skin. I really liked that the serum is applied by dropper, so I can use it without contaminating the product. The glass is dark to light protect the ingredients!

Feels good going on and feels great on the face. Lots of good ingredients too. My only issues are the dropper- it doesn't always pull up product, so I have to try a few times. Also the strong fragrance, I'd prefer less scent

avis.titre: Works well, but dropper doesn't really work
avis.texte: I did love this product. There is a light, flowery scent and it makes your skin feel smooth and helped to reduce some wrinkles under my eyes. I do have a deep smile line on my cheek, it didn't really help there, but smaller wrinkles I did see a difference. The only complaint I have about this is the packaging. The dropper is an awful way to get this product out of the bottle. The formula is too thick for a dropper.

Review is based off the 30 days I had from when I received the product until the review was due. This cream did not irritate or dry out my skin. It also didn't cause any breakouts. It is not thick and spreads on smoothly. It also doesn't have a scent that I could smell. It doesn't leave a greasy film and after it dries, makeup can be worn over it. I did like this product and feel like it did help a little. I took before and after pictures so you can be the judge. For the price of this product I would have expected better results. But, atleast there were results.
Only Been using 2 weeks Nice n smooth easily application no residue

Thank you for sending me this full size of Perricone MD Neuropeptide Deep Crease Serum in exchange for my honest review. I have been using this for 3 weeks on my face and neck area and I have been using this in the morning and evening and I love it. The texture is light, easy to absorb and it doesn't leave sticky feeling. This serum helps reduce my fine line wrinkles and increased skin density. Definitely recommend this.

avis.titre: Serum that smooths, hydrates, and brightens your skin!
avis.texte: This serum provided instant brightness and hydration to my skin! When I used it longer, I thought it was great for relaxing and smoothing my forehead creases. This was a silky, lightweight serum. It has a lovely floral (rose) serum that isn't overwhelming.

I am unable to load the after pictures. This product works! I do think the dropper is ineffective as the serum is pretty thick. I ended up not every using it. A little of this product goes a long way. There was a noticeable reduction in my laugh lines. Of I have the money I will continue to purchase as it clearly works. The scent is lightweight and didnt cause any reaction on my skin.

avis.titre: I can't wait to see my final results!!
avis.texte: I've been a Dr. Perricone fan for as long as I can remember and was so excited to add this product into my routine! I have dry skin and am in my mid MID 40's so I'm trying everything I possibly can to help my skin. I've been using this serum AM-PM and have noticed some results. Are they absolutely noticeable…No, but they are subtle and that works for me! What I'm noticing is a relaxed and plumper look around my laugh lines and the 11's between my eyebrows. My complexion is even looking less red than it normally does. I do feel a little bit of tightness and mild itching but nothing that would make me less likely to use. I just apply my moisturizer and the hydration comes back. My skin feels so soft and I'm not feeling any stickiness. I'm loving the pump and the amount of product you do get. I can definitely see myself purchasing. I would say the only drawback would be the Rose scent or at least that's what I'm smelling. It dissipates quickly though.

I am always skeptical of any product that states they will reduce wrinkles. I have had 2 deep creases between my eyebrows for a while now. The results are better than I thought. Not perfect, but I am impressed. It smells nice and has a good feel.

I hadn't tried much for Perricone Md before so I was really excited to give this a shot. I was surprised by the really thick consistency but it absorbs fast and layers well with my other skincare, so that wasn't an issue. I'll definitely be curious to see how long it lasts. I think this is one of those things that needs months of use before you know for sure, but as of now I'm definitely going to be purchasing another bottle. I honestly do feel like I see a subtle difference in my forehead lines roughly an hour after applying, they just seem less pronounced. I'll be curious to see the comparison between the "before" picture I took and what the "after" looks like when I run out and how my forehead lines look from then to now. I definitely have hopes for this serum, and if nothing else, it does feel nice and luxe to put on and makes my skin look nice!

Wow. This is basically filler in a bottle. It's luxe in every way. Beginning with a sterile application. The results are seriously magical. Nearly filling and erasing the appearance of deep lines and creases. For me, personally, my nasal labial folds have been a source of insecurity. I've even had them filled with juvederm. This serum does the job just as well as crazy as that may sound. It's a thick serum and super hydrating. Half a syringe takes care of the entire face and neck. It absorbs quickly while leaving behind a silky surface. I experienced zero irritation. I will be keeping this in my daily use as I'm addicted to the plump, supple and nearly filtered skin it is giving. Worth every penny. I will not hesitate to repurchase!

Have been using this product and seeing amazing results. I am 50+, but feel like I am doing everything I can to keep up my youthful appearance using this product. I found the consistency is cream-like which in line with other serums I have used in the past. I love Dr Perricone's products I've used in the past. I'm going to finish the bottle before I make a decision on purchasing based on price tag of product.

avis.titre: Save your money there are better products
avis.texte: For the price of this product I personally feel amazing things should have happend, unfortunately they did not. This product claims to show difference in 4 weeks, personally I do not see a difference. The applicator could also be much better, even from first use its hard to get the product to suck up the tube.

avis.titre: Seems to be doing the trick…
avis.texte: I really like this serum. I liked the packaging, that the instructions were clear, it came with a cap and a dropper, making it more convenient for travell. It has a nice texture and seems to be working ion the fine lines in my t-zone (forehead, around mouth and on neck). So far, so good. Thanks for letting me try it and review it.

avis.titre: Product felt nice but not all promised results were deliv...
avis.texte: Now that I'm in my early 50s I'm willing to try anything that will help with creases, expression lines, and crepiness. I've been a long-time user of Perricone MD products so this seemed like the perfect fit. The serum is thick, silky, and very creamy to the touch. It soaked into my skin quickly and was only slightly sticky after application. Any remaining stickiness faded after moisturizer use. I had no irritation or redness. My skin felt very moisturized and hydrated and looked a bit plumper thanks to the Niacinamide, retinoids, and CoQ10. But after several weeks use I was unable to replicate all of the product claims. The glass bottle packaging was very luxe. However, I had quite a few issues with the dropper. I'm not sure if it was just my bottle or a packaging flaw but very little would disperse from the dropper, and it was impossible to use the dropper twice without filling it up again, even if product remained inside of the dropper before refilling it.

Perricone MD Neuropeptise Deep Crease Serum is a great addition to my skincare routine! The dropper makes it easy to apply. Its creamy smooth texture absorbs into skin without feeling greasy. It does not irritate the skin and leaves skin feeling soft! I use it on clean skin and finish with my moisturizer!! No harmful ingredients or scents!!

I've been really enjoying the Perricone MD Neuropeptide Deep Crease Serum. The texture is light weight and absorbs quickly without any stickiness. I really like the subtle rose scent. Nasolabial folds and marionette lines have been a growing concern of mine lately, and after about 3 weeks of consistent use I've noticed a visible difference. Those areas look smoother and less pronounced. That alone makes it feel worth incorporating into my daily routine and I'm excited to see what long term use brings. A couple downsides keeping me from bringing it to a full five stars. The dropper isn't great and doesn't dispense product easily, it almost makes me wonder if I possibly received a defective dropper. I've also noticed slight pilling, especially if I layer too quickly or use certain products on top. That said the formula itself clearly works and it's still a serum I would definitely recommend.

This product is fine. I don't have a lot of wrinkles, but I didn't notice a change in any of the few that I do (mid-thirties). I will say that this product had a dropper in it and it did not work, which was agitating. The product went on well and was not thick or sticky, and it didn't have much of a scent. Not something I will ever go out of my way to buy.

Love this luxury anti aging serum that goes on easily and is lightweight. I have a smoother more refreshed look over time! You can feel well hydrated and plumper with each application. I have sensitive skin and felt like I could tolerate this product with no issues. Love this brand

The Neuropeptide Deep Crease Serum by Perricone MD is amazing. Honestly, each product I try from them makes me love them more and more. This serum soaks in immediately and leave your skin feeling like just hydrated skin. No residue at all. It is gentle and will fold right into your skincare routine. I can't wait to see the long term benefits. Oh and it's smells so good!!

I got this product free in exchange for my honest reviews. I am using this serum along with other perricone MD products. The serum definitely helps to fill the small small creases but nothing helping so far with my wrinkles. The scent is awful but stays for 2-3 second and then vanish so I don't mind much. No side effects so far. Come with easy to use dropper.

I love this product. I was not very optimistic about it improving my deeper creases but it surprised me. I'm not saying that it permanently removes them but it does a great job of plumping up your skin to make them less noticeable. Maybe with time it will become more permanent. The bottle is sometimes harder to get the thick product into the tube to dispense the product but that is my only negative. The consistency of the product is nice and absorbs well. It is not an offensive scent which increases my likelihood of continuing to use it. I will be adding this to my routine and repurchasing it.

This is so nice. I'm not sure it's made great headway on my deep creases but it has helped keep my skin happy and moisturized through a very cold and dry winter with no irritation. I've been using it for at least a month and I still have more than half a bottle left, so that's a good value. Smells nice, spreads and absorbs beautifully, doesn't fight with other products on top of it.

This serum is super hydrating! I've been using it for a few weeks but haven't seen major benefits in wrinkle reduction, but I do love the way it hydrates my skin. It's smooth and easy to apply. Not oily or heavy feeling. Just a few drops in areas of concern is all you need. It spreads nicely and doesn't leave an oily feeling.

I'm not sure how I feel about this product. I like how it makes my skin feel soft but I'm not sure it does what it says it does in regards to my wrinkles. After fairly consistent use I haven't noticed much of a change in my deep forehead wrinkles. I will keep using it because at the very least my skin feels softer after use. I don't know that I would recommend this for wrinkles though.

avis.titre: Even AI can see a difference
avis.texte: Even comparing the photos on ChatGPT it acknowledges the blue shirt photo shows a more crepey look over the current photo that appears more hydrated and indicates the use of products to aid in hydration of the skin! This product is helping me recover my skin from my weight loss surgery and I will definitely continuing using!

I have used this product daily as Instructed for about 3 weeks, and i seen no improvement. My lines are pretty deep, so that may be the problem. It is easy to apply and a little goes a long way. There is no smell and i had no adverse reactions. It did hydrate my skin and my makeup easily applied over it once it completely dried. #Influenster #perriconemd

I received this from Influenster in exchange for an honest review and have been using this for about a month now. So far, I have loved this serum. It's been easy to incorporate into my routine. I use it after my Omnilux red light mask and swapped out my Medik8 peptides while I was testing this. While it's probably too soon to tell the difference when it come to creases, it's left my skin feeling radiant, plump, hydrated, moisturized, and evened out skin tone. It looks great under makeup as well and seems to smooth out texture. I've used it under both foundation and tinted moisturizer. I'm 39, have husk dry skin, sensitive skin that is both dehydrated and lacks moisture and I also deal with autoimmune issue. I've had no redness, sensitivities, or any issues using this. If anything, it's somewhat calming. It is scented, but it's a pleasant smell I look forward to using and most of my products are unscented. So it speaks to the quality of the product. My Medik8 peptides I usually use are very sticky and tacky (but effective). This has a silky, smooth, none tacky texture. So if you don't like tacky textures, this is for you. My only con, is the dropper. It seems to be faulty. I have to squeeze several times to pick up product and release product.

I love this serum because I noticed results within a few uses and it helped my skin look healthy, glowy, and plump. I have sensitive skin and this serum was gentle but effective. It is lightweight but very hydrating.

avis.titre: I like the feel of this serum
avis.texte: So far it seems to be working. I would like to review in a month.
Definitely made my skin feel firm. Easy to apply and a nice consistency. Will definitely become a part of my routine. Worth the price I would say for sure.

I received this product for FREE from Influenster for my honest review, I honestly can't tell much of a difference, maybe I'm just too old with too many wrinkles. It does have a nice feel & it's very absorbent, it doesn't take much & there is a tightness when applying. The ingredients seem normal I suppose, I tried this for the duration I was supposed to to be able to see some difference but it just didn't happen.

I received a neuropeptide decrease serum complimentary from influenster from my honest review. It is a silky texture serum has a little bit of a floral scent. The serum supposed to help with wrinkles which I've been using it for 3 weeks now. I haven't noticed much reduction but do notice my skin's more hydrated in certain areas. The fine lines wrinkles have minimized more.

This is such a lovely serum! The scent is beautiful — a soft, light rose that feels very luxurious without being overpowering. It absorbs quickly into the skin and doesn't leave behind any residue or tackiness, which I really appreciate. Most importantly, it hasn't caused any breakouts. After a few weeks of consistent use, I do feel like my "11 lines" and some of my forehead lines look a bit softer and smoother. The brand also mentions dark spot improvement; I haven't noticed a change there yet, but I'm hopeful with continued use.

This is an okay product, but after 2.5 weeks of daily use I haven't seen much change in my skin. This is a very thick serum and I find the dropper dispenser a bit hard to use with this product. I feel like my skin tone has improved and my skin does appear more radiant, but I would not say it has decreased my deep creases yet. I find a little of the product goes a long way and if you apply to much your foundation rolls up in that area, so light application is key. I will continue to use this for a month and see if I can up my rating- it's definitely helped my skin, but I wouldn't say it's tackled the deep creases much.

Really nice serum. It goes onto the skin very easily and gets absorbed quickly. It has a great feel to it and leaves me feeling moisturized but not wet or tacky. Hard to see any long term affects yet of the crease results but so far I'm liking it. I don't love the smell but it's not strong or overpowering. I just don't care for Perricone MD's signature scent they use in their products. I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review. All opinions are my own.

avis.titre: Deep Creases Don't Stand a Chance!
avis.texte: I truly like this Deep Crease Serum by Perticone MD. It's a very nice texture and thickness. Easy to apply and it doesn't leave you feeling sticky. I apply it in the morning, once it dries I do my makeup. I didn't get any breakouts from using the serum, no stinging or redness which a great. It absorbed very nicely when applied to my face. The packaging is wonderful, glass container and the applicator is very easy to use. I would definitely recommend this brand, I have there tinted moisturizer and I love it! Goes so nicely with then deep crease serum.

Pericone MD Neuropeptide Deep Crease Serum works good. I like the way it applies, I like the texture and that it doesn't feel like it leaves a residue. It's also doesn't have any scent which is great. The only thing that makes it a little difficult is the applicator. It is difficult to get product out. I did notice a change in my 11 between my eyes it is not as deep as it was. It also feels smoothing in my skin and works well under makeup.

I received this product free for my honest review. I have enjoyed this serum. A light citrusy scent when applying, it is a creamy texture that spreads easily and blends in smoothly under makeup with minimal pilling. It made my skin feel very nice. I don't think it decreased wrinkles but certainly made my skin softer. Hopefully after longer use it diminishes the appearance of fine lines.
I really wanted to love this product but the strong and bad scent just makes it impossible. I tried several nights and it does goes on smoothly and my skin feels good after.

This is my first experience with the Perricone MD brand. I received the Neuropeptide Deep Crease Serum complimentary from Influenster. I wanted to target the lines around my eyes. The serum is moderate thickness, has a mild scent, and hydrates skin well. 3 drops covered my whole face. It worked well under makeup or with SPF layered over it. I don't love the dropped applicator and would prefer a pump. I used this a month before reviewing. I see some mild improvement to the lines around my eyes and my skin feels well hydrated and soft.

I usually apply in the morning and night and it soaks right up in my skin no redness or breakout with my sensitive skin. I apply my moisturizer after it has been fully soaked in and have had no issue but also haven't seen a big difference. I included two pictures one with glasses frames with Christmas lights that was around Christmas and the second from today and even though I've been using this regularly I haven't seen any massive changes. At the very least it does help make my skin feel super soft.

These are before and afters of my neck and forehead. I can't get over how well this worked on the deeper lines on my neck. Even my finer forehead lines are diminished. This is after two weeks of using it every night. I will be buying this again and again!!

The first thing I noticed was the spa like fragrance of this cream/gel. The texture is light and absorbs quickly into the skin. The dropper is nice for keeping your product hygienic but I wish it dispensed a bit more product.

I wanted to test this product for a bit before giving my review and I have honestly loved it so far! It is light weight and silky, no stickiness. Goes on smooth and has a nice smell, skin feels hydrated! Have seen an improvement on a few deep lines that I'm sure will work better with time. Overall, I would recommend Perricone Neuropeptide Deep Crease Serum.

So, I have been slathering this on for a few weeks now hoping my wrinkles would just pack their bags and leave but the jury is still out on that front. I am not seeing a massive transformation quite yet but I am a patient person so I will give it some more time before I make a final call on the most important part of the deal. Honestly though the actual experience of using the serum is pretty lovely because the glass packaging feels fancy and the pipette is actually easy to use without a struggle. It feels incredibly hydrating and smooth on my skin like my face just finished a tall glass of water. No irritation at all. No scent either. I am definitely going to keep using this to see if the magic eventually happens.
Love it. It's like a running yogurt texture, and absorbs pretty face, I used for 5 days and I do see a little difference!! Definitely will keep it up.

Need to use this product over a longer amount of time to see real results, but I think it does help with deeper creases. My skin looks smoother after starting to use this. The bottle seems like it will last a long time too which is a bonus.

Ok… I've been using these twice a day for a couple of weeks. I love the dropper (gives a tiny amount) and love the consistency. It melts right in as a serum should. I (obviously) have forehead "deep creases" …. And I'm working at them. I've used Perricone products for a long time off and on and believe in the science and quality. These lines won't disappear overnight but I'm confident they're softening and improving. If anything can do it short of Botox- I have faith that this can. I just don't like Botox so this is a meaningful alternative for me.

I love how quickly this serum shows its results. The absorption is amazing and the ingredients are very good and don't irritate my skin. I love how it makes my skin feel refreshed and isn't irritating
Very thick for a serum, dispenses nicely with dropper which is included in the packaging . No heavy scent or residue. Leaves skin feeling soft, may reduce look of wrinkles temporarily.
Love this lightweight moisturizing serum. It's a light scent that doesn't smell over powering. My face felt more moisturized using it and love that it has natural peptides

Perricone MD's Neuropeptide Deep Crease Serum has a thin, almost gel-like serum texture that absorbs quickly into the skin leaving it feeling hydrated. It contains neuropeptides, biomimetic growth factors and plant stem cells to reduce wrinkles, improve skin elasticity and increase skin thickness over time. I have seen some improvement in my forehead wrinkles in just a week and will continue to use to hopefully see even more improvement!

I am absolutely obsessed with this product. I've been using it for a month, and I have seen a reduction in the creepy texture of my skin underneath my eyes. The scent is so refreshing and not overpowering. It is a lightweight serum that provides instant hydration. It didn't irritate my skin and it was easy to add into my current skin care. Peptides are going to be the new trend for skin care in 2026 as they are super powerful and can help combat signs of aging.
Great viscosity. Perfect weight for a serum. Absorbs nicely leaves a bit of a floral fragrance. Leaves skin plump and moisturized looking. Will try for longer results but happy so far.

I've been using this deep crease serum for a couple weeks and have noticed some smoothing and light exfoliation. It is gentle on my skin and soaks right in (I'm normal to dry). I have some deep creases around my mouth that I have been working on and I'm looking forward to seeing results! My only (minor) negative is the dropper doesn't work well with this thicker serum- it just can't fully manage to push out all the product. That is not stopping me from using it, however! It does have a bit of a natural scent but it goes away once dry. Overall, I do recommend and I think this one could show great results with consistent use.

This is a good serum. I noticed slow changes but for sure some change with fine lines under my eyes. It is an easy serum, with milky texture to apply. I love a good dropper serum like this as it makes applying so easy and clean.

Perricone Neuropeptide Deep Crease Serum is definitely a high end anti-aging serum designed to target wrinkles and lines. The bottle is transparent looking which gives it a modern luxury look. It feels weighty and upscale that matches the price point. The serum has a lightweight and silky feeling that I love. It seems to go a long way. I am using it twice a day and it seems to working on my nature skin. This a premium product worth trying.

Perricone MD does it again. I have tried other products from this line but it was my first time trying this specific product and it has earned itself a place in my starting line-up. I enjoyed the consistency of this product, it was thin so a small amount went a long way. It was powerful enough that I felt like if I didn't want to do a second step to my routine, my skin was still getting enough moisture and care. Because of how lightweight it felt on the face I actually used it in the morning under my makeup and it made for a wonderful primer. It helped plump up my fine lines and created a smooth base for makeup application. When I used it at night it had a quick dry down time so I was able to quickly add another step or night cream on top of the product. My pores stayed clear and after 30 days of using it I didn't experience any breakouts or skin irritation. My only small complaint is that the dropper didn't work great, I had a hard time getting product in the dropper or it spilled out while moving it to my face. I wish it had a pump. That could have been a me issue though, so I'm not that concerned. Overall I would purchase this product again and really enjoyed the results and performance of this product.

Overly this deep wrinkle serum seems to work okay. I wouldn't say it's completely altering but I feel I've noticed some additional smoothness to problem areas. The serum is thick and the dropper doesn't really work well due to this. It dries down pretty fast and there's no weird smell which I feel like many can have. Overall I'm pleased with the results.
I think this is really helping my feel creases on my forehead. They seem to be less visible. It works well with other products and does not cause build up.

I have been using this deep crease for a couple of weeks now and I have notice a slight difference in my forehead crease. It drys down very well without looking oily. It absorbs into my skin making it feel soft. I love that it came with a pump easy to apply on. It's added into my skincare routine

avis.titre: Already noticing my lines are less noticeable!
avis.texte: The @perriconemd Neuropeptide Deep crease serum is awesome! It's a silky serum. It contains neuropeptides, biomimetic growth factor peptides and plant stem cells to smooth the look of deep lines, wrinkles and creases around the eyes, lips and forehead. I've only been using it for a couple of weeks and already noticing my lines appearing less noticeable. You have to be sure your skin is completely dry after cleansing/toning or it will pill up on you. Also be sure it's completely dry prior to using your moisturizer. I am glad this is in my skincare routine. It's great! I love the earthly scent as well. #influenster #perriconemd

I'll preface this by saying I generally love Perricone products and I do like this one. A little goes a long way and it feels great. It smells very clean and fresh and not too over powering. It's great for my combination skin type. It's not drying but not too greasy. It's settles in nicely and leaves my skin feeling soft and minimizes fine lines. I think as I use it more it will help even more. My only complaint is the bottle dropper. It seems to not work as well as it should. But I can deal with that!! I like the product!

Perricone Neuropeptide Deep Crease Serum is such a nice luxe step in my skincare routine! The texture is silky and lightweight, so it glides on easily and absorbs without feeling sticky. I've noticed my "11" lines looking a bit softer and my skin feeling smoother. It layers well under moisturizer and doesn't interfere with makeup. I hope after longer use, all my fine lines go away.

I love this product. It doesn't really have a scent. It feels smooth and nice. It doesn't leave your face oily. I provides a sort of blur to the fine lines. I'm a fan of this brand and all it's about.
I've been using this product for about 6 weeks now and I'm really pleased. It's very light and absorbent. There's no scent which is very important to me so it doesn't not irritate my skin.

I received this Perricone MD Neuropeptide Deep Crease Serum free from Influenster to try and then give my honest opinion. It is wonderful! It comes with a plastic dropper, to ensure easy application of the serum. The consistency has a milky like formula. It is thick but not too thick. It has a slippery, silky feel when applied to the skin. After using it for a few weeks I can see a noticeable difference in the deep wrinkles and creases around my mouth. The seem softened and less noticeable. It sits comfortably on the skin. It has a slight floral....rose scent to it. The scent doesn't linger long. The product has wonderful ingredients which my aging skin needs! I have really been enjoying using this serum. I will continue to use it in the future.

I was so excited to try this serum. It is very lightweight and absorbed in quickly and cleanly. I love that it is free from parabens and sulfates. It has a light floral smell that goes away quickly. I haven't been using it for very long, but have noticed slight improvement in the lines on my forehead and my crows feet.

avis.titre: Smoothing Out My Stubborn Forehead Crease
avis.texte: I'm honestly impressed with the results. I had a deep forehead crease that always seemed to stand out no matter what skincare or makeup I used. This serum helped soften and smooth the look of it. The texture is lightweight and absorbs beautifully into my skin.
Super simple and smooth application. No foul odors or residue. I have definitely noticed a change in my forehead and smile creases, they were always my focus before.

This serum goes on smooth. Has a thick consistency. Absorbs well. Face feels way better right after you apply product. No irritation or sensitivity to product so far. Looking forward to seeing the long term advantages of the product.

I use every night for the past week now. I can say this product definitely works on some level. I can see the difference in my skin after using it. My skin feels moisturized and you can see the difference. The consistency is that of a moisturizer and just rub a small amount into the face and neck for results.

I have just began using the deep crease serum. Interestingly, as soon as I applied it, it was as if I could feel the skin tightening. Having used Perricone MD products for 30 years. I trust this product will prove to be very effective.

I have to say that I've been using this for two weeks and already see improvements to my skin. I'm 45 years old and I find that this has helped with my lines, texture, and I see a glow. At first, I had some issues with it pilling but I have worked around that and removed some other products and have better results now. It is a bit thicker than some serums so I use it towards the end of my skin care routine. I found that I do have to spray a facial spray prior to applying it to help with the pilling. I've noticed some decrease in fine lines around my eyes and around my forehead and lip area. Just so everyone knows paracone MD products does have a scent but that does not mean it is bad. They just do not use any type of perfumes or fragrance to hide it and you're just smelling the natural ingredients. That being said it doesn't linger or make me grossed out.

This deep crease serum really does reduce the appearance of lines especially under your eyes! It is very lightweight with no scent. The only drawback is the bottle and dropper application. Although the serum is not thick the dropper does not work well to dispense the product and it does not pour out of the bottle. I think if it was contained in a small jar or pot it would be easier to apply.
Was happy to get this.. this made my skin very soft. This isnt greasy at all. U will have a glow until it soaks it..helps with appearance of deep creases and lip lines

I am in awe of the Perricone MD Neuropeptide Deep Crease serum. It makes my skin feel exceptionally soft and look very smooth. It helps to hydrate and smooth out my frown lines and forehead. My skin feels bouncy, youthful, and looks renewed. I like that it is non greasy, as I have oily skin. It absorbs easily and pretty quickly into my skin. It layers well under my moisturizer and makeup.

This serum is hydrating and not irritating, it is formulated to work on deep creases as the packaging states. Doesn't have a strong scent to me. It absorbs into the skin nicely. So far it has helped my skin look more refreshed and glowy with consistent use. I have to keep using it longer I think to see if there is any solid results for deep creases and softening them. I do like this product a lot though and I think it's a great addition to my skincare routine. Perricone MD makes great skincare products.

This serum light pleasant scent and goes on incredibly smooth. I t's better than I expected and perfect for winter dry skin hydrates without feeling oily, softens the look of open pores and has an all-around great texture.

This is a wonderful serum. I have been using it daily as part of my skincare routine and I have noticed some improvement on my deep creases on my forehead lines, my lips lines seem to disappear after just using it for a couple of days. The serum absorbs instantly in my skin and leaves a soft feeling without feeling greasy. Overall I was very pleased with this serum and will continue to use it and try other Perricone MD products for my skin.

I was absolutely impressed after using this serum for just a couple of days. I have been using daily as part of my skincare routine and I have noticed how my deep creases on my forehead and frown lines seem to disappear. This serum absorbs instantly leaving a soft feeling. Overall I was very pleased with the results. I would highly recommend it

I love it. A little goes a long way. Smoothly and well made. I can feel the hydration it gives me when I used it all day. I started noticing the difference less noticeable lines and softness. Doesn't have a bad scent. Is like botox in a bottle.

I received this product from #Influenster and #Perricone MD for my honest review. This serum is a must have! The results are almost instant My creases deep lines and wrinkles are much less noticeable. It has a pleasant scent and absorbs fast. This is the best product I have ever used for deep creases lines and wrinkles it delivers excellent results!!!
